steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Rus, are you done packing?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Victoria's not like Kjerag. We're trying to work with the other side this time. Our standing's weak, and they WILL take advantage of that to tear us open.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: The only thing I can tell you is, there's no way of guessing what they're going to do exactly. It's up to you to determine.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Alright, alright, I get it! You're going to chew my ear off, ugh!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: If you have so little faith in me, why don't you do it yourself?!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Turn your brain on for once in your life and figure that out YOUR-self.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Why you...!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Alright, I've got no time to argue with you. Remember, this isn't an all-expenses-paid vacation. You're representing the Browntails.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Yucatan, keep an eye on your wife. Don't let her do anything stupid that would embarrass our clan.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Don't nod to that! Yucatan, whose side are you on?!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Don't get sidetracked.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Short version: pay more mind on this one. Eyes out, ears out, mouth shut. Don't shoot off like you did before.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: It's time you went out and broadened your horizons, anyway. Go and see the lands outside of Kjerag. See just what kind of place Victoria is.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hey, you know... Ratatos.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Is it me, or do you really wish you were going yourself?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Rus, over here.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hands to yourself, bitch! I don't have a temperature!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: So why are you talking out of your ass?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I-I was just asking.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: If you had the chance back then... would you have wanted to visit Victoria, Ratatos?

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Ah, I finally found you two!

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Too many guests just now, swarming me, I tell you! Pardon me for leaving you in the lurch.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hardly, Mr. Harrison.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Thank you for inviting us. We've been having a delightful time.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Now, how nice of you!

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: I couldn't very well neglect you, not after you've come so far. Help yourself to any food or drink here, and if you need anything else, just fetch the closest servant.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: That's very kind.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Oh, do you need me to quickly demonstrate how to use all this cutlery?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: ...We'll be fine.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Mr. Harrison, I think we should set that aside, and start discussing partnership arrangements between the Browntails and your own firm.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Ooh, very to-the-point, Madam Sciurus...

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: But I'm given to believe we've already reached firm consensus, haven't we, vis-a-vis partnership?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: That is so.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: But I believe we still need to work out the details of a few terms.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Of course, you have no need to worry whatsoever.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: My assistant has the contract all ready. You can look over it whenever you have a moment to...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I've already read that contract.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Let me be blunt. The Browntails cannot accept some of the terms within it.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Mm, hm...

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: So, your proposal, exactly?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: We need to renegotiate the exact figures for provision of labor and revenue share.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Hmm.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Yes, I will consider your concerns.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: So—

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Hold your beasties, now, Madam Sciurus.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: I'm of the mind that I've already been very generous with your cut on these orders.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: But...!

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Now, not to worry, this is still the same win-win for us, and I have a very good impression of Kjelac myself. I would never have you or your family come out of this with losses.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: It's 'Kjerag,' not 'Kjelac,' Mr. Harrison.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Oh? Ah, of course, silly me, I always have trouble pronouncing that.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: You've visited Kjerag before?

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: That... I can't say I have, but, quite some word of it has reached me in recent years.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: I've heard they roast entire meatbeasts at Kjelac dinner parties, the wine comes in big jars as tall as you or me, and they put on variety shows and the like too. I shan't for the life of me miss a chance to see it myself.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You're joking.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Alright, I have to receive the other guests, now. Enjoy the party, my friends.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: W—Wait...! I haven't finished—

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Excuse me.

steps.name: Wealthy Woman
steps.text: (Mr. Harrison, there you are! Who are those two over there?)

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: (Guests from Kjelac, wouldn't you know. They're from a fairly prestigious family in the area.)

steps.name: Wealthy Woman
steps.text: (Ah, well, I've never heard of the place before...)

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: (It's nothing more than some far-flung mountains. Not worth your concern, Dame.)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: We're leaving, Yucatan!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Rus...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hrrrhhh...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hffff... hrrrhhh...

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Rus.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: We're alone now.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: AAAARRRGGHHHH HE PISSES ME OFF!!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: HE PISSES ME OFF SO

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: HE PISSES ME OFF SO

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: MUCH!!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: THE HELL IS HIS PROBLEM?! WHO LET HIM ACT SO HIGH AND MIGHTY AT ME?! YOU THINK I CAN'T TELL HOW MUCH YOU LOOK DOWN ON US, HUH?! ON KJERAG?!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: HE WANTS TO TEACH ME HOW TO USE CUTLERY? EXCUSE ME? WHO CAN'T USE CUTLERY?! WHO PUTS A DUMB SHOW IN HIS DINNER PARTY? AND HE DOESN'T EVEN CARE TO SAY KJERAG RIGHT! IF WE WEREN'T GOING TO BE BUSINESS PARTNERS, ON KJERA-DAMNED-GANDR'S NAME, I WOULD PUNCH HIM INTO THE SUN!!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I AM SO! SO!! SO!!! FURIOUS!!!!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: ...*sigh*.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Here, drink some water.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: No. My appetite is GONE.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Just drink some. Don't get those midnight stomach cramps.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You can massage me then!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Fine, sure. I'll massage you.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Rus, you did well to hold out so long.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hmph. What was I gonna do otherwise?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: If I went off right there, that bitch Ratatos would've jawed my head off later down the line.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: You did well.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: So where do we go from here?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Do you want to head back to the hall, or just go to bed for tonight?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Head back! Why wouldn't I head back?!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: All we got out of this was me, furious! We still haven't finished discussing the contract! Don't you dare think this is enough to make me back down!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Really? Are you okay?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Uh, duh, I'm fine. I'm doing just great.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I didn't need Ratatos to tell me. I understand partnering here in Victoria is the Browntails' first step to contact with the outside world. I can't mess this up.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Not just that, I need every trick I up my sleeve to get us some good out of this.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: So it's fine. I can bear it.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Rus...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Yucatan, you've seen everything I did the last two days—

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I've never seen such big machines before. They look so clunky, but they run so smoothly.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: And there were nice even streets all the way here, and stations everywhere, and the sheer stuff in the shop windows makes my eyes spin.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: They don't even use candles for lighting this dinner party. It's electric lights...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Yucatan, Kjerag doesn't have any of this.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: And I think we SHOULD have all this.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: It just takes trains, pretty cities, stores in rainbow colors! All we've gotta do is build them!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: And then our kids can grow up around it all, and then when they're big, they can study abroad, they can go be tourists... wherever they want to go, they'll be able to.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Um, you said 'kids'...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: N-No! I didn't mean THAT! W-What are you thinking?! I meant, um, you know, Kjerag's future children...!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Calm down, calm down, Rus, it's not on my mind, it hasn't been—

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What? You've never thought about us having kids before?!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: I have... no, wait, not in that sense!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ahem.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Basically, we need to do more, for the future, before we can rest.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: That's what that stupid, horrible Enciodes thought as well, wasn't it?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: All that roundabout crap was a little too complicated for me, but the railroads and factories that dipshit built... Kjerag's changed a lot thanks to them.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Rus...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What are you laughing at...?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Q-Quit patting my head! You're gonna mess my hair up!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Here, Rus, hold still. I'll sort it out for you.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I can't stand you... We're outside right now, you know!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Sorry, I couldn't stop myself.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: You're right. These are things we should have.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Things we will have.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Of course!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: But I never expected you to say it... or compliment Enciodes for once.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ha, don't be stupid, Yucatan! I'd never say anything nice about the Silverashes!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I'm just being realistic here. Enciodes might make me sick, but if this is what he's been seeing all this time, then I can slightly understand all the stuff he's been doing.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I admit he's got a little skill, that's all. I'm magnanimous enough to say that.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: It's true. Enciodes has finesse.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Besides, I hate that stupid Gnosis guy by his side way more than I hate Enciodes!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: If it wasn't for that bastard pulling his pretend betrayal and scheming against us...

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Under the circumstances, it was definitely a decent plan. Each side to their own, and none of the blame on him.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I don't care! What are you defending him for, Yucatan?!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: I'm not...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (Glare)

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Alright, that was my bad.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: But it's been so long since it all blew over. When we make deals with the Silverashes in future, we're bound to run into their people again... When are you going to let go of your grudge, Rus?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: When death pries it from my cold, dead hands.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Look, it's apples to pears! I'm not going to wreck Ratatos's business, but don't count on me forgetting what they've done!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: ...*sigh*.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Not that the Matriarch seems to mind at all anymore.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: How, exactly?! That bitch might act like she doesn't care on the surface, but truth is? Her grudge runs deeper than mine!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Did you forget when we were kids and went out to play and we didn't call her along, and then Grandpa caught us when we came back and we had to write lines for a week?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I'll still bet anything that was Ratatos's revenge! She DID that!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: You know we were playing outside for far too long, and that's why we were punished. We can't place the blame on the Matriarch.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Come on, you've got way too much faith in my sister!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You know, though, speaking of...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Yucatan, have you ever gotten the feeling she kind of admires Enciodes?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Not like she's said it, but I can vaguely sense it.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Hmm... I agree, actually.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: If it wasn't for Enciodes's methods afterwards being too extreme, the Matriarch might not have reacted the way she did.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You think so too? Say... you think the reason she put me onto this one was—so I could see all this?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Before we left, I asked her if she would've wanted to go to Victoria in those days too, if she had the chance.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Really... I know how she's been thinking.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ratatos! Ratatos!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ratatos! If you're there, answer me! I've been yelling forever! I bet you're just pretending you can't hear me again!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Why are you ignoring m... huh? What are you staring at?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Why shouldn't I ignore a little scumbag who doesn't even invite her sister?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Who're you calling a scumbag?!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: A little runt who sneaks out to play all by herself and still wants me to cover for her, that's who.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: *cough* I'm... I'm sorry, that was my fault that time.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Next time I'll bring you! I'll get Yucatan to watch out for us!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Forget it, I'm busier than you anyway, and Grandpa's health is... whatever, who cares. Just don't stir up trouble for the next while, alright?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Also, stop depending taking advantage of Yucatan. You're practically bullying him.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: How am I bullying him?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Because I said you are.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: So. What do you call me?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ratatos...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: The Firstborn! My elder sister!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: That's better, dear sister.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hold on, are you trying to trick me again? Don't dodge the subject. What are you looking at?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Just some periodic intel reports, nothing special.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Grandpa lets you do this stuff already? He really trusts you...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Because I'm capable of handling it, unlike my darling little sister.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Why you...!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Fine, I'm not picking a fight with you.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What kind of news is there this time? I mean, you've been staring at this forever...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Doesn't look like anything special...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hm? The Silverash Firstborn's already left Kjerag?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: He went to study at Victoria... Wow, he's great at excuses. I bet he couldn't stand it in Kjerag any longer, so he just ran to somewhere else!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Is that what you think?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: That's what everyone says. If we can stay, then who'd want to go somewhere they don't even speak the same language? I know I wouldn't.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What? Ratatos... the Firstborn, what's with the funny look?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Stop. Put your hand away. I'm not at the point I need YOU to worry for me.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You bitch... I was being nice!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Enough. Thanks for being nice, then.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: It just fills me with something. It was all for the Silverashes' current situation, and him being able to push past his worries. That's what let him make a decision like this.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What decision?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: The decision to abandon everything.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Enciodes... you really are a callous man.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: That's what she said back then.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I forgot all about it, but when I saw her and that stupid Enciodes in the fire... I don't know why, and it was so many years ago, but it just instantly came back to me.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: That's when it clicked. Ratatos wasn't occupied with any of the thoughts we thought she was.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Do you think... the Browntail clan has been a burden on her, this whole time?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Was this before the end of the Patriarch?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Yeah. Not long after that, Grandpa passed away.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You know now that Grandpa's health was already shot by then. Ratatos just kept the wool over our eyes...

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Too many people had eyes on the Browntails, and the Matriarch was still too young. Some people were bound to get ideas.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Yeah. It got so busy for her she didn't even sleep. She had the heaviest bags under her eyes and thought I'd just miss them... Her temper got awful too. Ragging on me all day.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Yucatan.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Back when I wasn't convinced, when I kept trying to disagree with Ratatos... I was being such a dumbass, wasn't I?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: No—

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Okay, stop, don't you say anything!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Mmph!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I know I was stupid then and I didn't help anything, but I sure ruined plenty! I was stupid to the max! It's fine, okay, I know all the way deep down!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: It's whatever from anyone else, but you're the only one who can't say it.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You're not allowed to yell at me. I wouldn't be able to take it.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Rus... let me finish.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: You're brilliant. I've never once thought you were stupid.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ugh, you... How do you say this stuff so straight?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Hmm? Do I?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: I don't think you're stupid, and neither does the Matriarch...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: She totally does!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Alright... but she wouldn't fault you. You've always been trying to do a little something, and she's always trying to put faith in you. Haven't things turned out pretty great now?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I know that, I'm just still a little... angry.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Angry at myself, and angry at Ratatos.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Why couldn't I realize sooner, and why does she have to love showing off so much?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Well... do you want some real talk?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: If it's not nice, don't say it.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Come on, that won't do.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Showing off probably runs in the Browntail family by now. You're not much different to her there, Rus.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: So, our reluctant bravery-lover Madam Sciurus, do you have a plan to persuade that Mr. Harrison, and knock his greed down a few pegs?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hold on... what noise is that?

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: What a wretched dinner party.

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: Am I to believe Mr. Harrison has the courage to purchase a noble's land, but not the bravery to receive me as a guest face-to-face?

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: You lot.

steps.name: Hostile Man
steps.text: Your orders.

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: Give our Mr. Harrison a little gift.

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: No cold feet to be had here. Teach this man how the mercantile should treat the aristocracy.

steps.name: Hostile Man
steps.text: On it!

steps.name: Wealthy Woman
steps.text: Argh!

steps.name: Wealthy Woman
steps.text: Q—Quickly, fetch Mr. Harrison!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (What the hell? They're wrecking the whole hall.)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (Is that Victorian noble their leader? What is this meant to be...?)

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: (Looks like he and Mr. Harrison got into a mix-up.)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (He's destroying the house. That can't be your average mix-up.)

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: (Want me to take a look?)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (Hold on a bit longer. We can't just show up that casually. At least not right now!)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (But I think this might just be a good opportunity...)

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Viscount Evans!

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: W—We're honored to have you! Why didn't you send word in advance? I heard you were holidaying in Leithanien; I hardly thought...

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: Mr. Harrison, you're quite the well-informed one on the subject of my travels.

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: You hardly thought I would return early. I imagine I've thrown a hardy spanner in your schemes, Mr. Harrison.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Tha—Tha... What are you...

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: Now, Mr. Harrison, none of that silly countenance.

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: You've been fraudulently snatching up shares in our joint firm, depressing prices and then purchasing the land on the sly while I was gone from the country. Not a good fit with your pathetic, wide-eyed look.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Viscount Evans, is this really called for?!

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Our partnership is still in effect! If it's a question of interests, we can still hash things out again... This is hardly how you treat your joint associate!

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: But of course I haven't forgotten our partnership.

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: And yet still, I would dearly suffer for not letting off a little steam here.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (A dispute of interests between this merchant and this noble...)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (Ratatos pushed me through a bunch of material before we left, so I knew about this, but who knew I'd see it first-hand.)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (But with this...)

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: (Do you have an idea, Rus?)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (Yep. You just asked me if I had a plan for how to negotiate with Mr. Harrison.)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (Now I do—quick, Yucatan, here's our chance!)

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: You can't... You can't just do this!

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: Oh, can't I?

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: Mr. Harrison, let's be crystal-clear. Suppose I *do* do something to you! Then, they'll report that 'Pitiful Sir Harrison sadly passes away in duel with Viscount.'

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: Bahah, you can't possibly hope they'd lay hands on a noble?

steps.name: Hostile Man
steps.text: (Sir.)

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Hostile Man
steps.text: (People got a lot of our guys knocked out now, only a few up still.)

steps.name: Hostile Man
steps.text: (And seems one of the guests called the police. Look...)

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: You're not as dull as you suggest, Harrison. Fine job on finding some lackeys.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: Enough of the tomfoolery!

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: I'd come in thinking there would be future leeway for discussion if you were tactful enough here, but it seems you don't quite agree.

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: Hmph. Today was just a lesson. We're far from through yet.

steps.name: Noble Man
steps.text: We're leaving!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: They're just gone now?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ugh... What about these guys, then?
The red-haired Zalak carelessly dumps the people over her shoulder in front of the magnate.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Just put them here. Someone will deal with them.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Ah... are these all—Viscount Evans's...

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: You don't mean those 'lackeys' he mentioned were—

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: If you don't have anyone else to choose from, then I imagine you mean us.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Are you alright, Mr. Harrison?

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: I escaped the worst of it, though I must seem an awful fool to the two of you, and, well, er...

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: No matter what, I thank you with all my soul.

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Only, having set about to the Viscount's men like so, I worry in future, er... *sigh*...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Mr. Harrison.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Let me be straightforward about that—your partnership with that noble's in for a rocky ride, isn't it?

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You've publicly offended him now we've beaten up his entourage, and it looks like he's a rung on the ladder above you, so you've got no way to get at him. Is he going to just keep working with you?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Based on what I know, your firm is in the key phase of its expansion right this moment, and if your partner pulls out midway, that'll be a massive blow to you, right?

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: Wh... What are you getting at here?

steps.name: Victorian Magnate
steps.text: You can't be telling me you just did all that on purpose?!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Come on, I'm doing nothing more than talking facts here, that's all. Don't go and overthink it.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You're stuck between continuing to beg to that noble, or searching for a new associate under pressure. We have a small, little proposal there...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: We Browntails are one of Kjerag's Three Clans. A single puny Victorian noble poses no threat to us. If you're inclined, the Browntails will be your most reliable business associates.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: How about that, Mr. Harrison? Regarding that partnership between us—

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: —Is it me, or do you think we can renegotiate now?
